mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cut_approval_notification WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND channel_code = 'IN_PLATFORM' AND (status_code = 'PENDING' OR (status_code = 'PENDING_RETRY' AND next_retry_at <= #{query.dueAt})) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_retry_at, create_time) ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{query.batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT * FROM cut_approval_notification WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND deleted = b'0' AND channel_code IN ('SMS','EMAIL','DINGTALK') AND (status_code = 'PENDING' OR (status_code = 'PENDING_RETRY' AND next_retry_at <= #{query.dueAt})) ORDER BY COALESCE(next_retry_at, create_time) ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{query.batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
